svg.text: * Separate ClinVar submit prevents violating Explorer QOS limit of 8 submitted GPU jobs (LM array already uses all 8 slots)
60 jobs ÷ 8 tasks = up to 8 per task
Tasks 0–7 each run ≤8 manifest lines sequentially
fits 8 sub / 4 run / 4 GPU QOS exactly
Shared Filesystem · ~/rbp-binding · All nodes read and write the same directory
GPU nodes share NFS filesystem — a prep task on any CPU node writes /data/, a V100 fine-tuning job on d1017 reads the same path without any data transfer step.
